board.note: 20x20 square grid. Starting corners: Blue(0,0), Yellow(19,0), Red(19,19), Green(0,19).

polyomino.note: 21 distinct polyomino shapes per player (1+1+2+5+12, monomino through pentomino). Each piece is placed once and cannot be moved.

place.constraint: First piece must cover player's starting corner. Each subsequent piece must corner-touch (diagonal adjacency) at least one of the player's existing pieces. Must NOT edge-touch (orthogonal adjacency) any of the player's existing pieces. All cells must be empty and in bounds. Pieces may be rotated and flipped.

pass.constraint: Player may pass if no legal placement exists. Game ends when all players pass consecutively.
